summary: @reneehobbs My bias comes from being an old middle school language arts teacher. I hate using a word in the definition of said word. A close second is using the same word twice in one sentence. Truth can have style.

body_html: @reneehobbs My bias comes from being an old middle school language arts teacher. I hate using a word in the definition of said word. A close second is using the same word twice in one sentence. Truth can have style.
